Download the file for your system:

- **macOS** (Apple Silicon, macOS 13+): `_aarch64.dmg`. Open it and drag Notching into Applications. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
- **Windows** (10/11): `_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `.msi`.
- **Ubuntu / Debian**: `.deb`. Install with `sudo apt install ./Notching_*.deb`.
- **Fedora / openSUSE**: `.rpm`. Install with `sudo dnf install ./Notching-*.rpm`.
- **Other Linux distributions**: `.AppImage`. Run `chmod +x Notching_*.AppImage`, then start it.

The Windows and Linux builds are not code-signed. On Windows, SmartScreen may warn: click "More info", then "Run anyway".
Linux needs webkit2gtk 4.1 (Ubuntu 22.04+, Fedora 38+). Shelf, Screenshot, Cleaner, Keyboard Cleaning Mode, Music and the Mirror lamp are macOS-only for now.
